section_summary.extract_value: This section presents bivariate analyses and ANCOVA results comparing bisexual women and other sexual minority women. It found no significant differences between the groups in age, BMI, or education, but a significant difference in sexual relationship status. An ANCOVA, controlling for sexual relationship status, indicated no significant differences in BAS scores between bisexual women (adjusted M = 3.73) and other sexual minority women (adjusted M = 3.69) in Study X.
